title: Fortress and Atlas Points Guide: Origins of Divinity Progression (PoE 2 0.5)
summary: How to earn every Atlas passive point in Path of Exile 2 0.5: raise the Precursor Fortress, beat the Arbiter of Ash, forge the Origin Core, and repeat-kill the Arbiter of Divinity to auto-complete whole regions.
description: A route-first guide to the PoE 2 0.5 Fortress and Origins of Divinity: the Fortress structure, the unlock route, an Atlas point ledger, boss gates, Trade vs SSF paths, a missing-points diagnostic, and real community cases.
prerequisites: Campaign completed and the Atlas map screen unlocked
A small stock of identified Waystones and capped resistances before pinnacle fights
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Arbiter of Divinity, the pinnacle boss at the summit of the Precursor Fortress in Path of Exile 2 0.5

items.title: How many Atlas points are there in 0.5.4?
body: There are 311 Atlas passive points. The Fortress is now the only source of them - completing Fortress maps and the Arbiter loop replaces the old per-map point grind.

items.title: How do I start the Fortress?
body: Run your first Precursor (Lost) Tower near the Atlas start. Completing it raises the Precursor Fortress on the Atlas.

items.title: What is the fastest way to finish the Atlas?
body: Beat the Arbiter of Ash, then repeat-kill the Arbiter of Divinity. Each Divinity kill auto-completes a whole Fortress region worth 40+ points, so roughly five kills finishes the entire tree.

items.title: Do I need to respec the Atlas tree?
body: No. There is no respec because the tree has no permanent cost - only multi-choice nodes swap, and they swap freely in your hideout.

sections.title: What the Fortress is
paragraphs: Patch 0.5 reset the Atlas and replaced the old point system with the Origins of Divinity storyline. The Precursor Fortress is now the central hub: a large walled zone packed with maps, and the only place that grants Atlas passive points.

Inside the Fortress you open Gateways to reach new sections, push toward the Burning Monolith, and clear Enigma Chambers for the quest version of the Crisis Fragments. Those fragments are spent at the Burning Monolith to fight the Arbiter of Ash.
bullets: The Fortress replaces every old way of earning Atlas points.
Maps inside the Fortress walls grant the points directly.
Directional questlines branch out from the centre toward each league mechanic's hub.
Old pre-0.5 Atlas point guides are obsolete - do not follow them.

steps.label: Raise the Fortress
body: From the Ziggurat Refuge, run the nearby Precursor (Lost) Tower.
Completing it spawns the Precursor Fortress on your Atlas.

steps.label: Collect Crisis Fragments
body: Open Gateways, push toward the Burning Monolith, and clear two Enigma Chambers for the quest version of the three Crisis Fragments.

steps.label: Beat the Arbiter of Ash
body: Spend the fragments at the Burning Monolith to open the fight.
This gates the next Fortress section and reveals two new wings around the Origin Tower.

steps.label: Clear Patriarch and Matriarch Halls
body: Both wings need Tier 15 Waystones and have limited attempts.
Patriarch Hall (boss Phya) drops the Origin Spark; Matriarch Hall (boss Phyx) drops the Origin Cradle.

steps.label: Forge the Origin Core and fight Divinity
body: Slot the Origin Spark + Origin Cradle into the Precursor Reactor at the Origin Tower.
Place the forged Origin Core at the top of the tower to start the Arbiter of Divinity fight.

sections.title: Fortress layered map
paragraphs: The Fortress is a layered zone rather than a flat map. You move inward through Gateways (Ancient Gateway, then East and West Gateways) toward the Burning Monolith at the centre, with Enigma Chambers off the main path providing the Crisis Fragments.

Past the Burning Monolith, two wings wrap around the Origin Tower: Patriarch Hall and Matriarch Hall. The Origin Tower itself holds the Precursor Reactor and the summit fight against the Arbiter of Divinity.
bullets: Gateways unlock new Fortress sections - clear them as you push inward.
Burning Monolith: spend Crisis Fragments for the Arbiter of Ash.
Enigma Chambers: quest-source of the Crisis Fragments.
Origin Tower: Precursor Reactor (forge the Core) and the Divinity fight.

sections.title: Atlas point ledger
sections.caption: Where the 311 points come from. Exact splits should be re-confirmed on the live client.

cells.requirement: Clear maps inside the Fortress walls
Forge the Origin Core and win the fight
Find new hall encounters (orange beams) outside the Fortress, refight
Spend points earned from the above

sections.title: Boss gates and what they give
paragraphs: The Arbiter of Ash is the gatekeeper. Beating him opens the path to the Origin Tower wings and is required before you can assemble the Origin Core.

The Arbiter of Divinity is the summit. The first kill completes the questline and grants a large region of Atlas progression; every subsequent kill is a chase-unique farm that also unlocks more regions. The fight has unlimited attempts on repeats, so dying does not waste your summon items.
bullets: Arbiter of Ash: gated behind the three Crisis Fragments at the Burning Monolith.
Arbiter of Divinity: gated behind the Origin Core (Spark + Cradle in the Reactor).
Divinity repeats: orange beams outside the Fortress mark new Patriarch / Matriarch Hall encounters.
Cap resistances at 75% and bring Runic Ward before either pinnacle.

sections.title: Trade vs SSF route
sections.intro: Your league mode changes how you reach the Fortress, not the Fortress itself.

tabs.label: Trade League
paragraphs: Buy lower-tier Waystones from Doryani's shop for gold to sustain your early Atlas and reach the first Tower quickly.
You can skip some self-sustaining Atlas nodes early because you can top up Waystones from other players.
bullets: Doryani's shop sells Tier 1-5 Waystones for gold.
Use the saved Atlas points for broad map value and Waystone drop nodes instead.
Still grab Waystone sustain nodes before committing to one mechanic.

steps.label: Buy Waystones from Doryani
body: Use gold to buy lower-tier Waystones and push to the first Tower quickly.

steps.label: Raise the Fortress, then spec sustain
body: Raise the Fortress, then spend points on Waystone drop nodes.

steps.label: Progress the Arbiter loop
body: Continue the Ash -> Divinity route as normal.

tabs.label: SSF
paragraphs: You cannot buy your way past a dry Atlas, so Waystone sustain is mandatory before anything else.
Open the Atlas tree search bar, type 'waystone', and grab drop-quantity nodes early.
bullets: Constant Crossroads (20% increased quantity of Waystones found) is a priority.
The High Road (Waystones 20% chance to be a tier higher) accelerates sustain.
Reforge three same-tier Waystones at the Reforging Bench to climb tiers.

steps.label: Spec Waystone drop nodes first
body: Grab Waystone drop-quantity nodes before the Fortress push.

steps.label: Reforge up tiers at the bench
body: Combine three same-tier Waystones at the Reforging Bench to reach the first Tower.

steps.label: Raise the Fortress, then continue
body: Raise the Fortress, then proceed with the Arbiter loop.

sections.title: Why you are missing points
sections.intro: If your Atlas looks finished but the point total is short, pick the situation.

options.label: Ash beaten but no Divinity access
Old point guide gave wrong totals

rules.title: You have not forged the Origin Core
steps: After Ash, clear Patriarch Hall (Phya -> Origin Spark) and Matriarch Hall (Phyx -> Origin Cradle).
Both need Tier 15 Waystones and have limited attempts.
Slot both into the Precursor Reactor at the Origin Tower, then place the Core.

rules.title: Look for orange beams outside the Fortress
steps: Repeat hall encounters spawn outside the Fortress as you explore the outer Atlas.
The orange beams mark nearby Patriarch / Matriarch Hall encounters.
Push outward and reveal more of the Atlas if you do not see them yet.

rules.title: Each kill only completes its region
steps: The first Divinity kill auto-completes one region; later kills unlock others.
Roughly five Divinity kills finish the whole tree.
Find new hall encounters (orange beams) and refight to keep progressing.

rules.title: Pre-0.5 guides are obsolete
steps: The 0.5 update replaced the entire point system with the Fortress.
Ignore any guide referencing old Atlas point totals or per-map grinds.
Follow the Fortress -> Ash -> Divinity route instead.

defaultResult.title: General point recovery
steps: Raise the Fortress from the first Precursor Tower.
Collect Crisis Fragments, beat Ash, forge the Origin Core.
Repeat-kill Divinity, finding new halls via orange beams.

sections.title: Community questions, answered
sections.intro: Common Fortress questions from Reddit and video comments, each with our analysis and a direct suggestion.

cards.title: Do I need to clear every map manually?
body: Question: players assume they must complete all 30 Fortress maps.
Evidence: Divinity repeat-kills auto-complete whole regions.
Suggestion: kill Divinity ~5 times instead of hand-clearing everything.

cards.title: Where are the halls after my first kill?
body: Question: the original fragment maps are already green.
Evidence: repeat halls spawn outside the Fortress as orange beams.
Suggestion: explore the outer Atlas; do not reuse completed halls.

cards.title: Is the Divinity fight limited attempts?
body: Question: dying wastes the summon.
Evidence: repeats have unlimited attempts - dying does not waste items.
Suggestion: keep trying once geared; cap resistances first.

cards.title: Grand Project Tablets worth it?
body: Question: tablets to reach halls faster.
Evidence: prices swing from ~20 Exalted to 4-5 Divines.
Suggestion: only buy if the price fits your budget; manual search works.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.intro: Stuck at a gate? Pick the blocker.

rules.title: Run the first Precursor Tower
steps: The Fortress only appears after you complete a Precursor (Lost) Tower near the Atlas start.
Check the nearby Atlas maps for the tower node.

rules.title: Clear the Enigma Chambers
steps: The quest version of the Crisis Fragments comes from two Enigma Chambers.
They sit off the main path as you push toward the Burning Monolith.

rules.title: Fix your defensive layer first
steps: Cap all three elemental resistances at 75%.
Add Runic Ward from Verisium Runeforging.
Build effective Life + Energy Shield above 2,000 before pinnacles.

rules.title: You are missing a hall drop
steps: The Origin Core needs both the Origin Spark (Patriarch Hall) and Origin Cradle (Matriarch Hall).
Each hall needs a Tier 15 Waystone and has limited attempts.
Do not sell either drop by accident - you need them to refight.

defaultResult.title: General Fortress recovery
steps: Raise the Fortress, collect fragments, beat Ash.
Clear both halls for Spark and Cradle.
Forge the Core and fight Divinity.
